parquet_encoding.purpose: Lossless UTF-8 transport-record round trip with independently verified row digest

unsupported: records without full update/delete before images
records without source transaction identity or commit LSN
unknown fields, profiles, versions, or schema identities
non-finite or binary floating-point identity values
limitations: This profile is a local synthetic contract profile shaped around DMS-to-S3 concerns.
It is not evidence of AWS DMS emission, S3 delivery, ordering, retry, or recovery behavior.
